The '''DC-15A blaster rifle''' was the weapon of choice for the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic's]] [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]]. A version with a wooden [[Stock/Legends|stock]] was the standard weapon of the [[Senate Commando/Legends|Senate Commandos]]. It was a larger and more powerful long-range alternative to the [[DC-15S/Legends|DC-15S]].

==Description==
[[File:CloneDC15A_-Fathead.png|thumb|left|180px|A [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone trooper]] using a DC-15A.]]
The DC-15A [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] was one of the standard issue weapons for [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]]. While the use of [[Blaster/Legends|blasters]] allowed a [[Cloning/Legends|clone]] trooper to carry significantly more ammunition than a projectile weapon, the DC-15A weighed a heavy 9.5 pounds, and despite the weapon's size, it was not a true dedicated repeating blaster rifle; the inherent instability of [[Plasma/Legends|plasma]] gas in the blasters reduced the weapon's accuracy under sustained fire.<ref name="Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary">''[[Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> Even so, the DC-15A was very powerful and deadly in the hands of the skilled clone troopers that received extensive training in its use.

The weapon's [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas cartridge carried enough gas for up to 500 shots, depending on the power settings of the weapon, while the charge pack lasted about 50 shots<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront Elite Squadron">''[[Star Wars Battlefront: Elite Squadron]]''</ref> To replace a charge pack, the user hit the release button located directly behind the pack, slid it out, and put in a fresh one. To replace the tibanna cartridge was more difficult. The wielder snapped open the blaster and removed the old cartridge from the buttstock, and then snapped it back in place. Like its smaller cousin, holding the trigger down produced sustained fire, with the drawback of decreased accuracy. On the top of the blaster was a triangular object that encased circuitry, with a wiry switch on it that controlled the power settings to the weapon. Its power-charge magazines ionized the gas into charged plasma within its ignition chamber. These bolts would then be accelerated out of the rifle electromagnetically. The octagonal-like barrel would compress the plasma into a thin bolt.<ref name="Star Wars: The Complete Visual Dictionary" /> On the high setting, the large rifle's powerful blue plasma bolts were more than capable of penetrating the [[Armor/Legends|armor]] of most infantry personnel and could blow a 0.5 [[Meter/Legends|meter]]-wide hole in any [[Ferrocrete/Legends|ferrocrete]] wall.<ref name="CCS">''[[Star Wars: Complete Cross-Sections]]''</ref> Because of the hyper-ionization, they were exceptionally effective against both droids and living targets.<ref name="Star Wars Battlefront: The Official Game Guide">[[Star Wars Battlefront: Prima Official Game Guide|''Star Wars Battlefront'': Prima Official Game Guide]]</ref>

[[File:FivesBlaster-CC.jpg|thumb|right|200px|A training version of the DC-15A.]]
In addition to standard iron sights on the rifle's upper surface, the DC-15A could interface with the helmets of clones to project a graphical gun-sight on the clone trooper's heads up display. It also included a sniper scope that could double as a handhold in storage position. Mounted on a tripod, the maximum effective range of a DC-15A was 10 [[Kilometer/Legends|kilometers]].<ref name="AOTC:ICS">''[[Star Wars: Attack of the Clones Incredible Cross-Sections]]''</ref>

The DC-15A also proved to be a good weapon to have on hand if a clone unit confronted large biological threats, one such encounter being the [[Battle of Felucia (Outer Rim Sieges)/Legends|Battle of Felucia]], where the 501st used it to great effect in an unexpected confrontation against several wild [[Acklay/Legends|acklay]] beasts.

==History==
[[File:DC15A_cold_assault_trooper.png|thumb|left|200px|A [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|clone cold assault trooper]] firing a DC-15A]]
Manufactured by [[BlasTech Industries/Legends|BlasTech Industries]], the [[DC-15]]-series was a range of plasma weapons used during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II">''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]''</ref>

While on [[Rugosa/Legends|Rugosa]], [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]] used his lightsaber to cut a DC-15A rifle into a crutch for use by the injured [[Thire/Legends|Clone Lieutenant Thire]].

[[File:TCWpromo-ClonesVsDroids.png|thumb|right|300px|The DC-15A rifle saw heavy use in the Clone Wars]]
On [[Boz Pity/Legends|Boz Pity]], an [[IG-100 MagnaGuard/Legends|IG-100 MagnaGuard]] nearly [[Battle of Boz Pity (Clone Wars)|killed]] [[Asajj Ventress/Legends|Asajj Ventress]] with a DC-15, although she managed to survive.<ref name="Obsession">''[[Star Wars: Obsession]]''</ref>

[[11 BBY/Legends|Eight years]] into the reign of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[anti-trooper]]s bred on Kamino would use these weapons to [[Kamino uprising|fight against]] the Empire.<ref name="Star Wars: Battlefront II" />

These weapons were also used by [[Dark Novatrooper]]s in the Imperial special forces. These were heavily modified, bulked up, and equipped with extra firepower.

[[Captain/Legends|Captain]] [[Judder Page/Legends|Judder Page]] also used this weapon on [[Caluula/Legends|Caluula]] during the [[Yuuzhan Vong War]].

==Behind the scenes==
[[File:DC-15A_Loading.jpg|thumb|left|210px|An [[Advanced Recon Commando/Legends|Advanced Recon Commando]] checking and charging his DC-15A]]
The DC-15A blaster rifle that the majority of the clone troopers carry in [[Star Wars: Episode II Attack of the Clones|''Attack of the Clones'']] and [[Star Wars: Episode III Revenge of the Sith|''Revenge of the Sith'']] is based on parts from the [[Wikipedia:German|German]] [[Wikipedia:MG34|Maschinengewehr MG34]] from [[Wikipedia:World War II|World War II]] (the same gun was used as the basis for the [[DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle/Legends|DLT-19 heavy blaster rifle]] in the [[original trilogy]], albeit the DC-15A has more cosmetic modifications to make it look like a completely different weapon, while the DLT-19 is just an MG34 with a Gas cartridge installed to the right side of the receiver).

In ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront]]'', the Clone Trooper unit utilizes this weapon and the model is also used for the Clone Pilot's DN Bolt Caster.

In ''[[Star Wars: Battlefront II]]'', the DC-15A blaster rifle is used by the Clone Trooper and Clone Marine units. Its model is also used to represent the Clone Engineer's [[Shotgun/Legends|shotgun]].

In the [[Star Wars Miniatures]] line of miniatures, the DC-15A was used as placeholder weapons for [[Republic soldier|Old Republic Soldiers]] and [[Sith trooper (Sith Empire)|Sith Troopers]], despite the DC-15A being invented much later.
